basic_details.job_title: JPSC CCS Mains Exam Date 2026 - Download PDF
basic_details.short_information: Jharkhand Public Service Commission (JPSC) has released the exam schedule for the Jharkhand Combined Civil Services (CCS) Main (Written) Competitive Examination-2025 (Advertisement No. 01/2026) through a press release dated 14 July 2026. The Main exam will be held on 25, 26, and 27 July 2026 in two shifts per day at various exam centres in Ranchi district. This article covers the exam date, shift-wise paper schedule, admit card download process, and all official instructions exactly as stated in the JPSC notification.

important_instructions: Check the downloaded admit card, attendance sheet, and exam centre details carefully. Report any error at the JPSC enquiry counter in writing by 24 July 2026; requests received after this date will not be considered. Biometric and IRIS verification will be conducted at the exam centre. Candidates should reach the exam centre by 8:00 AM for the first shift and by 1:00 PM for the second shift. Candidates must reach the exam hall at least 30 minutes before the scheduled start time and be seated. Entry will not be allowed 15 minutes after the exam begins. One answer booklet will be provided for each shift. Read the instructions printed on the admit card, attendance sheet, and answer booklet carefully before filling the required details on the OMR section of the answer booklet's cover page. Candidates are solely responsible for any missing or incorrect entry. It is mandatory to appear in the examination for all papers; otherwise, the candidate will not be included in the merit list of the Main Examination.

faq.question: Q1. When is the JPSC CCS Main Exam 2026 scheduled?
faq.answer: The JPSC Combined Civil Services Main (Written) Examination-2025 (Advt No. 01/2026) is scheduled on 25, 26, and 27 July 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many shifts are there each day?
faq.answer: There are two shifts each day: the first from 10:00 AM to 1:00 PM, and the second from 2:30 PM to 5:30 PM, each 3 hours long

faq.question: Q3. How many papers are there in the JPSC CCS Mains exam?
faq.answer: Based on this notification, six papers (Paper I to Paper VI) are being conducted across the three exam days, two papers per day.

faq.question: Q4. What documents should candidates carry to the exam centre?
faq.answer: The downloaded admit card and attendance sheet for the relevant paper, 4 passport-size colour photographs per attendance sheet, and a valid photo ID proof.

faq.question: Q5. Will JPSC send the admit card by post?
faq.answer: No. As per the press release, admit cards will not be sent to candidates by post; they must be downloaded from the official website.
